title: SwiftData: Unique Attributes & Pagination
hints: A `.unique` attribute turns a second insert with the same key into an update.
Read the existing `uses` first so the new insert carries the incremented count.
Page with `fetchLimit` and increasing `fetchOffset` until a page is empty.
jsBridge: `@Attribute(.unique)` makes inserts **upsert** on a conflicting key, like SQL `INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`. `FetchDescriptor` with `fetchLimit`/`fetchOffset` pages results.
